---
kind: property
by: the-town
tier: sovereign
date: 2026-10-21
name: entry
default: null
---

How a mark receives an arrival: its word (welcomed, neutral or opposed) and its terms. Where a door passes you through to (into, lands_at) and what it asks to hold first (requires) are the door's own fields, not entry's (the-town/door; Darko, 2026-11-25). Every mark subclass inherits it unless its class redeclares it. A mark with an inside is entered; a thing has none (`the-town/the-not-ground`; WLD-212), so thing redeclares it as none, locked (the-town/thing-entry), and a thing whose effective entry is still none (unless the town's own subclass loosens it) receives no arrival: what passes you through is a door, a class of its own. A mark that writes none answers the town's standing default.
